environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed with Function URL where AuthType is set to AWS_IAM. The function's resource-based policy specifies a principal condition (aws:PrincipalOrgID) restricting invoke access to identities within a specific AWS Organization. The Function URL endpoint returns HTTP 403 {"Message":"Forbidden"} for any request that does not carry a valid SigV4 signature from an IAM principal belonging to the organization. Note: the function itself has no code-level auth checks - the IAM auth enforcement happens at the Lambda service layer before the handler is invoked. The SIGALRM-based timeout logic remains unchanged and the race condition exists in the code, but unauthenticated attackers cannot reach the handler to supply malicious payloads.
